title: A Survey on Web Application Testing: Over a Decade of Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2412.10476v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As one of the most popular software applications, a web application is a program accessible through the web that dynamically generates content based on user interactions or contextual data; examples include online shopping platforms, social networking sites, and financial services. Web applications operate in diverse environments and leverage web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Ajax, often incorporating features like asynchronous operations to enhance user experience. Due to the growing number of users and the popularity of web applications, the quality of these applications has become increasingly important. Web Application Testing (WAT) plays a vital role in ensuring the functionality, security, and reliability of web applications. translated_title: 网络应用测试综述：跨越十余年的演进
translated_abstract: 作为最流行的软件应用之一，网络应用是一种通过网页访问的程序，能够根据用户交互或上下文数据动态生成内容；例如在线购物平台、社交网络站点和金融服务。网络应用运行在多样化的环境中，并利用HTML、CSS、JavaScript和Ajax等网络技术，通常结合异步操作等功能来增强用户体验。由于用户数量的增长和网络应用的普及，这些应用的质量变得越来越重要。网络应用测试（WAT）在确保网络应用的功能性、安全性和可靠性方面发挥着关键作用。鉴于网络技术快速演进的速度，WAT尤为重要。在过去十二年中，人们开发了多种WAT方法。这些方法的多样性反映了该领域的快速发展。
tldr: 本文综述了网络应用测试领域在过去十余年中的演进，系统梳理了多种测试方法的发展，强调了网络技术快速变化背景下WAT在保障应用质量中的关键作用。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews the evolution of web application testing over the past decade, systematically categorizing diverse testing approaches and highlighting the critical role of WAT in ensuring application quality amid rapid web technology changes.
